changes.method: Exact minimum-cost assignment to disjoint courtyard slots by independently mapped CPU supply function. Apply the explicit coordinates in editable tscircuit source.

qualitativeRequirements: CPU bypass capacitors close to the corresponding supply terminal, with short low-inductance returns
SRAM supply bulk capacitors near the input terminals with wide connections
Internal LDO capacitors close to their own terminals, without external loads
constraints.measurementScope: Package-center to supply-ball geometric distance. It is a lower bound on a routed connection and does not prove loop inductance, impedance, capacitance or transient performance.

remaining: Critical PMIC/boost/regulator and feedback placement/copper review
LCD source resistors and other circuitry in the DDR routing region
Complete routed bypass loops, dedicated vias, reference planes and effective capacitance
Measured original shell fit and all inherited power, panel, Linux and manufacturing qualification gates

proximityTradeoff.note: Exact courtyard spacing improves the group overall while ten individual distances increase. SRAM internal-output capacitors move from 1.52/1.81 mm to 2.26/2.78 mm. The current distances do not qualify the actual copper loops; those four outputs need explicit short, wide routing and local return review.
